acceptanceCriteria: An over-bound range refuses with identical output without decoding the snapshot (test or measurement retained)
body: Measured 2026-10-18 on origin/main 6ceee260b (build 668): `corvint impact --base <HEAD~20>` returns unsupported-impact-range ("impact range exceeds the 100-path bound") after 0.4 s CPU / up to 1.3 s wall and ~430 MB RSS, most of it LoadSnapshot/gob decode plus git status. The range's path count is known from the diff alone. Expected: count the range paths and refuse before loading the snapshot, with the same refusal bytes. Agents and hooks that call impact on long-lived branches pay this on every refusal.

title: impact --base decodes the whole index snapshot (175 MB) before refusing a range over the 100-path bound
